about_short_description.short_description: Bits helps people build their credit score by providing them with a digital credit card that they pay off every month.

product.name: Bits Credit Card
product.description: A low-limit Mastercard credit card designed to help users build credit by reporting to major credit bureaus.

product.name: Bits Store Card
product.description: A store credit line linked to a subscription plan allowing users to buy vouchers and pay part upfront, with the remainder added to a credit line to build credit.

product.name: Bits AI App
product.description: A personal finance app with an AI chatbot that provides spending insights and financial tips using bank data accessed via Open Banking.

product.name: Rent Reporting Service
product.description: A service that reports users' rent payments to credit bureaus to help build credit history.

product.name: Bits Store Gift Cards
product.description: A selection of over 40 gift card vouchers from UK retailers available for purchase through the Bits Store.
